observations.behavior: Adds a fanout-dependent endpoint configuration and a date-filter parameter to GuruEndpointConfig; the class becomes frozen and its primary_key can now be a list.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to support hierarchical or dependent API endpoints, while also supporting a server-side date filter for incremental queries.

observations.behavior: Adds several new endpoint configurations including group_members, folders, folder_items, tag_categories, tags, and analytics_events, with various primary keys and fanout dependencies.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds ingestion support for additional Guru entities and analytics events, including hierarchical relationships and date-filtered analytics exports.

observations.behavior: Adds HTTPError to the test imports, indicating the connector now raises HTTPError for certain failures.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes failure handling to raise HTTPError rather than generic exceptions, supporting better error classification.
